screenSummary.playArea: The play area has a data table you can edit, a graph of the chosen y column against the chosen x column with a fitted curve, and a graph of the residuals.
screenSummary.controlArea: The control area has buttons to open a CSV file, paste a table, load sample data, add a row and export; choosers for the x and y columns and the fit model; fields for the range of x used by the fit; and a Reset All button that clears the range and keeps your data.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Open or paste your data, choose the columns, then set a range to fit only part of the data.
